newsitem.title: UK: NatWest Markets to unveil new structure - paper.
newsitem.headline: NatWest Markets to unveil new structure - paper.

text.p: The chief executive of NatWest Markets, Martin Owen, will announce a new management structure for the investment bank on Monday, the Daily Telegraph reported.

It said Owen's new team would include Peter Hall as new chief operating officer and president to assume day-to-day responsibility. Hall, 47, is currently president of NatWest Markets in North America.
He would work with a team of four, the newspaper said.
It said Phil Wise, currently senior managing director in global financial markets, would become chief administrative officer with responsibility for risk, operations and technology.
"We are moving to an American-style operating structure," the paper quoted Owen as saying. "We will be a lean, mean fighting machine with the focus on clients."
The newspaper said deputy chief executive Roger Byatt, 56, would retire after 40 years with the bank. -- London Newsroom 44-171-542-7950
